---
title: "Phase Individual Loci"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
# create output directories
outdir_assignment <- file.path(currentdir, "06_assignment")
outdir_phased     <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "03_phased")
sapply(c(outdir_phased), function(x) {
  if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})
```

```{r phased-loci}
# create two sets of phased loci
ls_sets <- list(both   = ls_results$blocks[ls_results$blocks$tier == "both", ],
                single = ls_results$blocks[ls_results$blocks$tier %in% c("both", "single"), ])
ls_sets <- lapply(ls_sets, function(x) { x[x$decision %in% c("keep", "flip"), ] })
sapply(names(ls_sets), function(x) { dir.create(file.path(outdir_phased, x), recursive=T, showWarnings=F) })

# read the exon table
df_exons <- data.table::fread(fn_exon_table)

# create doSNOW cluster
nwcl <- makeCluster(params$thread)
registerDoSNOW(nwcl)

# iterate over loci
df_summary <- foreach(locus = unique(df_exons$locus), .combine='rbind') %dopar% {
    # input files
    fn_ref       <- file.path(outdir_best_hits_flanked, paste0(locus, ".fna"))
    fn_block_cds <- file.path(outdir_blocks_cds, paste0(locus, ".fna"))
    exons        <- df_exons[df_exons$locus == locus, ]

    # unphased consensus of the whole locus, then extract its CDS
    fn_consensus <- file.path(outdir_phased, paste0(locus, ".consensus.fna"))
    f_generate_consensus(fn_target_loci = fn_ref,
                         fn_snps_vcf    = fn_snps_vcf_gz,
                         fn_out         = fn_consensus,
                         exe_bcftools   = params$exe_bcftools)
    consensus <- f_extract_cds(fn_consensus, exons)[[1]]

    # extract the CDS blocks
    block_cds <- Biostrings::BStringSet()
    if (file.exists(fn_block_cds)) {
        block_cds <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(fn_block_cds)
    }

    # assemble and save the two parental haplotypes for each set
    ls_out <- lapply(names(ls_sets), function(set) {
        # extract locus blocks in the corresponding set
        blocks      <- ls_sets[[set]][ls_sets[[set]]$locus == locus, ]

        # extract the two haplotypes
        haps        <- f_build_phased_locus(consensus, block_cds, blocks)
        names(haps) <- paste0(params$sample, "_", names(haps))
        Biostrings::writeXStringSet(haps, filepath=file.path(outdir_phased, set, paste0(locus, ".fna")))

        data.table::data.table(set        = set,
                               locus      = locus,
                               n_oriented = nrow(blocks),
                               n_iupac    = sum(!strsplit(as.character(haps[[1]]), "")[[1]] %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T", "N")))
    })
    
    return(data.table::rbindlist(ls_out))
}

# save the summary
data.table::fwrite(df_summary, file=file.path(outdir_phased, "phased_loci_summary.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F)

# update the log file
n_oriented <- tapply(df_summary$n_oriented, df_summary$set, sum)
readr::write_lines(c("", paste0("Phased loci: h0 = ", ls_results$lineage_A, ", h1 = ", ls_results$lineage_B),
                     paste0("Oriented blocks: ", paste(names(n_oriented), n_oriented, sep="=", collapse=", "))),
                   file=fn_log, append=T)
```
